question: Montane forests have which of the following types of wildlife species?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Yak__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Montane forests,** at** 1,000-3,500m altitude**, have dense, humid vegetation, cooler temperatures, and high biodiversity, crucial for water regulation and endemic species.
 
• **Climate** : Tropical to Tundra.
 
• **Trees **: Magnolia, Iaurel, Cinchona, wattle, Oak, Chestnut, Walnut.
 
• **Regions** : Western Ghat, ** Nilgiris ( Shola )**, Vindhya, Himalayan Foothills ( J&K , Himachal, Uttarakhand, Arunachal, Nagaland, Manipur ).
 
• **In India's montane forests, notable endemic species** include the Nilgiri Tahr, Lion-tailed Macaque, Kashmir Stag (Hangul), Nilgiri Marten, and the Western Tragopan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Scorpions **are **nocturnal arachnids **with eight legs, pincers, and a stinger; they've existed for over 400 million years.
 
• **Sloths **are slow-moving mammals** native to Central and South America**, spending most of their lives hanging upside down in trees.
 
• **Sloth species' IUCN status varies**: Pygmy Three-toed Sloth is critically endangered, others like Brown-throated Sloth are least concern.
 
• **Snails have a unique feature called a radula**, a ribbon-like tongue with thousands of tiny teeth, used for scraping or cutting food.
